title: Native-tool versus retained JSON paper handoff: same24 development reuse

policy.primary: native_base minus retained_JSON_v4_base mean question-level reference-PMID Recall@10
policy.secondary: native_base minus retained deterministic direct PubMed full-question query
policy.frame: Same24 public BioASQ questions, already evaluated; exposed-label DEVELOPMENT reuse, not a fresh holdout.
policy.retrieval_benefit_rule: All guards pass and the paired95percentile interval lower bound is positive for the primary.
policy.agent_default_rule: Additionally require a positive paired95percentile interval lower bound versus direct PubMed; otherwise retain deterministic source-search default.
policy.all_empty_missing_and_failed_cases: Empty final rankings retained in the original24 denominator.
policy.cap_guard: Numeric completion_tokens>=1200 is terminal, including possibly complete calls at cap; missing numeric usage is terminal/unknown.
policy.protocol_factor: Complete native-tool protocol/controller profile; not a pure formatting causal ablation.
policy.tuning: One base-only profile, no skill/prompt/model/query sweep.

native_trajectories.interpretation: Choice/trajectory variation describes execution, not retrieval benefit or biological correctness.

native_nonparallel_policy.behavior: Select provider-parsed entry0 only when parallel_tool_calls=False; never scan later entries.
native_nonparallel_policy.suppressed_entries: Count only; no arguments/content/history/source execution/final handoff retained.

native_api_policy.choice_steps: auto with the qualified first-provider-parsed-entry return policy
native_api_policy.finish_only_steps: Standard named function tool_choice finish; explicit guided_decoding_backend=outlines.
native_api_policy.named_finish_response: Exactly one wrapped finish call, finish_reason=stop, full deterministic argument/ID/usage/cap guards.
native_api_policy.auto_response: finish_reason=tool_calls; stop is not a successful auto handoff.
native_api_policy.tokenization: Same exact tools through chat_template_kwargs and native history; tool_choice does not alter the pinned renderer.
native_api_policy.named_finish_rationale: Matches the retained JSON controller forced-finish catalogue; no free-text or new action budget.

retained_JSON_v4_base.cost_note: No API/model price table assumed; failed responses can lack token usage. Native process count is not HTTP request count.

retained_direct_pubmed.cost_note: No API/model price table assumed; failed responses can lack token usage. Native process count is not HTTP request count.

limitations: Same24 labels were already exposed: this is development evidence, never a new blind validation.
Reference lists are incomplete positive paper judgments; unlisted papers are not false or necessarily irrelevant.
Model/public training overlap is unaudited; source retrieval responses can differ in time for new native queries.
Protocol/controller/forced-finish differences prevent a pure formatting causal claim.
Cap guard can conservatively reject a complete native call; provider reason does not reveal the raw engine cause.
Candidate identifiers, variable tool trajectories and valid finals do not establish scientific entailment or independent Pharos evidence.
